book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Yesu Akina ki Bilatus
Nǝcil kǝlu, bas lǝɓasi ki Lya nǝ mikkina ki lashti zhil ki Musa, mus mi' dlil shilǝn is dlǝl shilǝn. Tǝngaki sǝ' kǝndǝ Yesu, is ziga nǝti, is bǝl Bilatus ti.
I Bilatus gyemti i' ultisu “Kiki guu ki Yahudawaya?” I Yesu ndǝgiti i'usu, “Nǝgu ki dlǝmi.”
I bas lǝɓasi ki Lya is gob dagǝtlti tǝnlǝɓa diɓǝli.
I Bilatus gyemti ɗanu i' ultisu, “Ki ngu, si dagǝtlti tǝn lǝɓa diɓǝli, kikǝn ndǝgissi waiya?”
Amma hal nǝguni Yesu appallisi shilǝnwai, i uli hwot Bilatus.
Apoci Yesu Mǝshti
Ulnǝ guu kuɗi pelti agas cin ki dadabǝl tǝn zakkissi mulnǝmi nǝm kige' kulkuku gunǝ mbalǝn ngemi u.
Mulǝnɗa si mbettiki Balnabas gunǝ ki kǝndǝ age' kulkuku u, ne'mi'ndǝlkiga ginǝ mbǝ mǝshti age' cin ki ndǝlkiga.
I dobga ki hwu mbalǝn is mbǝ ma'Bǝlatus tǝppǝlisi ulnǝ' kuɗǝ pǝlti u.
I Bǝlatus ngemsi i'usu, “Ki lyamtini ta zakikkin guu ki Yahudawaya?”
Gaki tamaniyi si usu gaki ngetti lakiɗa i bas lǝɓasi ki Lya bǝl Yesu a tohwasi.
I bas lǝɓasi ki Lya is datti mbalǝn shilǝn bi, sǝ'usu tǝzzakisi Balnabas ge'shuki Yesu.
I Bǝlatus ngyemsi ɗaɗanu, “I mikǝn ta pǝli nǝmulnǝ ki mbetti ki guu ki Yahudawa u?”
Is mbǝl la'ti yal tǝnki ɗaɗanu asi usu, “Tolǝnti tǝn gadlǝnnga!”
I Bǝlatus ngemsi, “Yalakiɗa? Bezǝn lǝɓa yakǝn tǝpǝli?” Is mbǝl tlǝlyal tǝnki asi usu, “Loti!”
Bǝlatus ɗǝ lyamti tǝppǝli mbalǝn ulnǝ mba tlwasǝn ɗǝ lyamti u, is zakisi Balnabas. Illaki is lǝ' Yesu u, ibbǝli, sǝ' tolti tǝn gadlǝnnga.
Sojoji is Laki Yesu Bi
I sojoji zǝga nǝti a tya bidla ɗǝ guu, (iki bidla ki gunti) is domi diɓǝl sojoji ga.
Is laki'lulǝgǝl undi ki gumsi mul hwula gagi, is pǝl kulu gawon ki gumsi ki ili, is shimi'ga.
Is go'shinitti si usu, “Tǝ Lya pǝli'pyasti ki mutti guu ki Yahudawa!”
Is go'li'titi aga nǝ kumbǝl, asi bezetti makǝn. Is ngus atli tǝnsi bǝtlti nalti.
Nǝspa' lakkitti bi nǝgu u, is tusi' lulǝgǝl ki guntisi taka, is lakki' lulǝgǝlwasi. Iki is sulti dla gaki sǝ'tloti.
Atol Yesu tǝn Gadlǝnnga Yi
Sige'zǝgga, sai mulǝn kǝngu ɗǝ ɓeuti, mulshin Siman, mulki Sayilin, mul zǝg Elekzanda nǝ Lupus, ti petite'ge' yakǝn gatlon, is la'ti nǝngesi ɗǝka' gadlǝnga ki Yesu.
Is tǝla Yesu ge'luwon si mbellǝbisi ki golgota, (iki “Luga mbalǝn”).
Alǝbi sitaki' malki inabi kigushli nǝ mul in nge tleti.
Iki is tolti tǝn gadlǝnga. Is bwas lulǝgǝlwasi age' dlomwasǝn, is pǝl kuli a tǝn gaki sǝ'en ulnǝ tǝ kowon ngi mbi u.
Nǝ dom ki nǝtapsi ki nikyeukǝn si tolti tǝn gadlǝnnga.
Is lash shilǝn ki dagǝtlti aga ɗa'ka, “Tiki Guki Yahudawa.”
Is tol mǝgǝlsi lop tǝn gadlǝnnga ne'ti, gudǝl nǝm tǝn toh shimti, gudǝl nǝm tǝn tohna.
[Gukǝ njikǝ'ki nasi u nǝ' usu, “Sa ɓǝtlti ge'mi' pǝl byas lǝɓa.”]
Mi'ɓeuti is go'pitti du shilǝn du shilǝn ya' shuge mbalǝn, asi wuga, asi ussu, “Kiwunǝ kin batti libi ki Lya, a'kǝni ge'mutti makwa,
Pe'sutɗǝtǝn gǝdlǝnnga uɗa, a' Pe'kǝl gawa' ɗa!”
Nǝgu bas lǝɓasi ki Lya ne'mi' lashti zhil ki Musa is gob lakkittibi age' dlomwasǝn asi ussu, “Tapekǝl gen i', bǝtaman pekǝl gawa swai!
Almasihu u, guki isla'ila, tǝppe'sudɗǝ tǝn gǝdlǝnnga nǝgun ɗa, mima anyeni anla' mbatlɗa.” Ginǝs tloti ne'tu sima is gob byalti.
Mǝshti ki Yesu
A bal dloncin, i dǝmshal idla atli, i dom maki ki su'pǝɗa.
Nǝ dom maki ki su'ti, i Yesu shilǝn nǝ ndǝlti i'usu, “Eloi, eloi, blama sabaktani?” (Iki, “Lya yini, Lya yini, ya lakiɗa i'lakǝntaka?”)
Nǝ ginǝ ki dlili alǝbi kumi nǝgu u, is usu, “In ngu, timbe' Iliya bi.”
Nǝ mwasǝn kitǝli, i lap soso ge'mbya mal ishimi tǝn kumbǝl It taki Yesu gaki tǝtle, i ussu, “Dlilni tǝn ya nini ko Iliya nǝn pekǝlti suɗi.”
I Yesu shilǝn nǝ ndǝlti, iki mǝshtwasi.
Iki labule kige libi ki Lya bwasi lǝbi lop, nǝ alya nǝ tli.
Mwani mul ndǝl ki mbalt, gunǝ ki dlǝlli akina ɗǝ Yesu u, nǝ' yen mǝshti, ki Yesu u i' usu, “Balini, mulu yakǝn ki Lya kǝni!”
Mudli yen is dlǝltel lolu ɗǝ yallu. Ge'si Malyamu Magadaliya, nǝ Malyamu dyaki Yakubu Yakǝni nǝ Yusupu, nǝ Salomi.
A te' Galili mudliyi bǝlti kali asi pǝlitti kyautǝn. Mudli yen ɗaɗanu diɓǝli nǝs mbǝne'ti a Ulshelima asi lǝbi.
Agu Yesu I
A suti, ɗǝ mbǝtti tǝlu cillu cin ki shuti ki Yadudawa.
Yusupu mbǝ, mulki Almatiya, mul dlil shilǝn kǝni, mul pǝli'mbalǝn zo'lǝɓa, mul ɓutti gukki Lya u, tǝ mbǝ. Ippǝl ndǝlki mbadli illǝma'Bilatus, in ngemi sǝ'bǝlti dliki Yesu.
I Bilatus kum gagashinti nǝ'kumi Yesu a mǝccu. Imbe soja yibi in ngemti balima Yesu a mǝccuwa?
Nǝm mani nǝgu u abiɗi soja u, ibbǝl Yusupu dli i.
I Yusupu wul likkapani ki lilin. Nǝ'shi' Yesu u, illa'ti ge'li'kapani ki lili i, illa'ti ge'lu gum mbalǝn gunǝs ɗugi ge' zǝnga u, ibbǝdǝl zǝga i tǝn bishu gun mbalǝni.
Malyamu Magadaliya nǝ Malyamu dyaki Yusupu is yen lu u nǝs guti ɗa u.
